Marissa —

Thanks for the ping. Answers below are written so you can paste them directly into an email to Amaya. Attaching the SOC2 summary and our retention matrix for reference.

1) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II (security, availability) — most recent report dated 2026-03-15. Scope covers Redwood's hosted control plane and production inference clusters; backups are included under storage controls (snapshots are covered by our encryption and access controls).

2) GDPR / HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports GDPR requirements and can be contracted for HIPAA-covered workloads. We offer a standard BAA for enterprise and Dedicated/Private customers; for Hosted customers we provide contractual safeguards and can execute a BAA for customers with an enterprise contract.

3) Data deletion SLAs: For customer-initiated deletion requests of primary/customer data we commit to start deletion within 48 hours and complete logical deletion of primary data within 30 calendar days (this removes data from active stores and indexes). Backups and immutable snapshots: standard retention is 90 days; backups are subject to our backup retention policy and are purged on a rolling basis. Practically, full physical removal from backup media can take up to 90 days after the primary deletion event. For Dedicated/Private we can support shortened backup retention windows and certify purge on request (subject to contractual terms).

4) Log retention: Default request and infrastructure logs retained for 90 days. Logs may contain limited metadata; we do not retain full user request payloads in long-term infra logs by default. Customers can request shorter retention (e.g., 30 days) as part of enterprise configuration or Dedicated deployments. We can also provide filtered log exports for audits.

5) Backups & proof of deletion: Backups are encrypted at rest and access-controlled. Purge workflow: when a deletion is requested we mark the dataset for purge; snapshots are then scheduled for deletion per retention cycle. For enterprise/Dedicated customers we can provide attestations of deletion and include deletion timestamps in audit logs. For Hosted customers we provide standard confirmation that data is removed from active systems and from backups per the 90-day window; we can expand audit detail under an enterprise agreement.

Attachments: SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (short summary), retention-matrix-2026-10.xlsx (retention windows by data type).

5) Backups & proof of deletion: Backups are encrypted and access-controlled. For enterprise/Dedicated customers we can provide deletion attestations and include deletion timestamps in audit logs. Hosted customers are covered by the standard confirmation and our retention cycle.
